title: Quadratic input consistency addresses
statement: For a natural number $n$, map the disjoint union of the $n$ input addresses and the $2^n$ linear proof addresses into the disjoint union of the $n$ input addresses and the $2^n+2^{n^2}$ proof addresses. Each input address is unchanged, and each linear proof address is sent to its corresponding initial proof address among the first $2^n$ positions.
